text:
ana: Quick follow-up from today's DR game day — thanks everyone for joining. Two high-level asks: 1) owners for each remediation, 2) realistic ETA. I'll kick off a tracker.
kevin: +1. I've started a Google Sheet but prefer we track in Jira. @sandra you volunteered to own routing tests?
sandra: Yep, I'll own multi-region routing validation. Plan: run failover sim Tue 2026-03-10, create runbook PR by EOD Monday. ETA: 72h for test + fixes.
mike: I'll take backups/restore runbook updates. Need access to snapshot logs from last game day. Who has S3 export creds?
julia: ops-bot created export task: export-1847654. @mike check run: s3://redwood-dr/sim-1847. I'll grant temporary creds.
ops-bot: export task export-1847654 completed. Files: snapshot-manifest.json, restore-log.txt
oncall-ivan: noted recurring pattern: KV-cache mismatch on failover caused ~2x cold-start. Root cause appears to be stale prefix keys after config rollout.
ana? No typos — ignore.
ana? -- REMOVED
ana: Good catch @oncall-ivan. Can we add a mitigation: invalidate KV prefix on routing switches? @kevin assign a patch.
kevin: will do. I'll open a PR to runtime with `cache.invalidate_prefix(region)` and add a canary toggle. ETA Wed EOD.
kevin: command example:
```bash
bin/cachectl invalidate --prefix region-us-east
```
sandra: Also discovered DNS TTL was 300s on the edge ALB. Need to reduce to 60s or implement app-level stickiness. Will draft change and test.
mike: Restore runbook: step for incremental restore currently missing `--verify-checksum`. Adding that now. Will push PR to docs repo: /infra/runbooks/restore.md
julia: tagging owners in tracker: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/DR-REM-1234
ana: Let's prioritize: P0 - restore verification (mike), P1 - KV prefix invalidate & canary (kevin), P1 - routing tests + DNS TTL (sandra), P2 - automated monthly game-day rehearse (julia).
kevin: For timelines, can we target all P1 by next Friday? P0 should be today/tomorrow.
mike: P0 PR submitted: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/984 — includes checksum verification and post-restore smoke test script. cc: @julia
sandra: routing test plan in PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/256 — includes scripted region failover and traffic shaping.
ana: I'll schedule a follow-up sync on Fri 14:00 PT to review blockers. If anyone needs help earlier ping me.
oncall-ivan: noted recurring incident pattern: two similar failovers last quarter. I'll compile a 1-pager with timestamps and correlated deploys.
julia: added monthly game-day recurrence: calendar invite sent to #eng-oncall and #eng-platform.
kevin: quick note: add instrumentation metric `failover.kv_miss_ratio` so we can alert before user impact.
ana: perfect — closing loop: owners + ETAs in tracker by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all :tada:
